categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
